testsuite.name: Rawa Dara - Sharing, Articles & Notifications (Iteration 4)
testsuite.details:
Tester: Rawa Dara
Software under test: UniShare (github.com/Seganation/unishare)
Test basis: UniShare_Iteration_4.md use cases UC-S4-001, UC-S4-003, UC-S4-004 and the tRPC routers course.ts, resource.ts, article.ts, notification.ts.
Techniques: Equivalence Partitioning (EP), Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), Decision Table (DT), State Transition (ST), Use Case / scenario testing (UC), Error Guessing (EG).

Common test data
Student A - Sarah Ahmed (sarah@student.utm.my), course owner, APPROVED, Faculty of Computing
Student B - John Doe (john@student.utm.my), APPROVED, Faculty of Computing (same faculty as A)
Student C - Michael Chen (michael@student.utm.my), APPROVED, Faculty of Engineering (different faculty)
Student D - Alice Wong (alice@student.utm.my), role PENDING (not approved)
Seed data: prisma/seed.ts (all seeded passwords documented there).
Course: "SECJ3343 Software Quality Assurance" created by Student A with one resource card "Lecture Slides" (file uploads allowed) holding file week1.pdf.

testsuite.name: TS-R1 Share Course (UC-S4-001)
testsuite.details: Owner invites students to a course. Techniques: EP, DT, EG.

testcase.name: Owner invites same-faculty student as VIEWER
testcase.summary:
Owner invites same-faculty student as VIEWER.

Test design technique: Use case (main flow), EP valid class

Requirements: REQ-SHR-03, REQ-SHR-07, REQ-NOT-01
testcase.preconditions: Student A logged in and owns course SECJ3343. Student B exists, same faculty, not yet invited.

step.actions: Open Courses > SECJ3343 Software Quality Assurance > Collaborators.
step.expectedresults: Collaborators page shows 'Manage who has access to SECJ3343 Software Quality Assurance'.

step.actions: Enter Student B's email in the invite field (colleague@university.edu placeholder).
step.expectedresults: Email accepted in the field.
Success message shown; Student B listed with role Viewer and status Pending.

step.actions: Log in as Student B and open the notification bell.
step.expectedresults: Notification 'New course invitation': 'Student A invited you to collaborate on SECJ3343 Software Quality Assurance'.

testcase.name: Owner invites same-faculty student as CONTRIBUTOR
testcase.summary:
Owner invites same-faculty student as CONTRIBUTOR.

Test design technique: EP (role = CONTRIBUTOR partition)

Requirements: REQ-SHR-03, REQ-SHR-07
testcase.preconditions: Student A owns SECJ3343. Student B has no invitation for this course.

step.actions: On the Collaborators page enter Student B's email, select 'Contributor', click Invite.
step.expectedresults: Invitation created with role Contributor, status Pending.

step.expectedresults: Invitation for SECJ3343 is listed showing permission Contributor and owner Student A.

testcase.summary:

testcase.summary:

step.expectedresults: Error 'You can't invite yourself'; no collaborator row added.

testcase.summary:

testcase.name: Invitation to a student from a different faculty is blocked
testcase.summary:
Invitation to a student from a different faculty is blocked.

testcase.name: Owner changes collaborator permission and removes collaborator
testcase.summary:

step.expectedresults: Student B shown as Contributor; Student B can now add a resource (see TS-R3).
Role shown as Viewer; Student B can no longer add resources.

step.actions: Click Remove for Student B and confirm.
step.expectedresults: Student B disappears from the list; SECJ3343 no longer appears in Student B's courses.
